invariants.note: Every profile keeps still images completely static. Only scene transitions and typography change between profiles.

ODD_FRAME_CLASSIC_V1_0.label: Classic v1.0
ODD_FRAME_CLASSIC_V1_0.description: Original ODD FRAME editing: static stills, hard cuts and Quick Pop captions.

ODD_FRAME_CINEMATIC_FLOW_V1_1.label: Cinematic Flow v1.1
ODD_FRAME_CINEMATIC_FLOW_V1_1.description: Static stills with scene-aware cuts, crossfades and dips to charcoal; animated center captions with a wave entrance, soft white glow and restrained golden emphasis.

transitions.rule: Hard cuts remain the default. A crossfade or dip must be justified by narrative meaning; the first scene never has a transition.

ODD_FRAME_CINEMATIC_TRANSITIONS_V1.label: Cinematic Transitions v1
ODD_FRAME_CINEMATIC_TRANSITIONS_V1.description: Narrative-aware scene transitions on static stills: purposeful hard cuts by default, graphic match cuts where the artwork truly corresponds, short and emotional crossfades and sparing dips to charcoal; wave + glow captions on a continuous layer above the stills.

guideline_distribution.note: Loose editorial guideline, never a quota: a tense mystery may be almost all hard cuts, a gentle story may use more crossfades. Narrative suitability always wins.

purposes.hard_cut: Default. Hooks, discoveries, reactions, changes of action, important beats, suspense, revelations, fast progression.
purposes.short_crossfade: Gentle emotional continuity, quiet moments, friendship, sadness, romance, subtle atmospheric change. Not where silhouettes would overlap awkwardly.
purposes.emotional_crossfade: Sparingly: important emotional pauses, memories, reflective moments, gentle resolutions. Not in fast suspense or action.
purposes.dip_to_charcoal: Meaningful time jumps, major location or chapter changes, dramatic separations. Never for an ordinary scene change.
purposes.graphic_match_cut: Only when two neighbouring stills deliberately correspond (shape, position, framing) as verified by looking at the artwork. Zero frames.

transitions.rule: Hard cuts remain the default. Every other transition must be justified by narrative meaning; S001 never has a transition; transitions are silent and never move the artwork.
